info.name: Calendar side panel
info.summary: Upcoming events in a right-hand panel, available from the header in every app
info.description:
Adds a calendar button to the top-right header on every logged-in page (Talk, Files, Mail, …). Clicking it opens a right-hand "Upcoming events" panel listing today through the next 7 days (ended events hidden, in-progress events highlighted) from all calendars you can see, including read-only subscriptions (ICS/webcal). Clicking an event opens it in the Calendar app.
Read-only. Does not modify Talk or Calendar.
info.author: Bill Pardi
